# Result tables (auto-generated by build-report.R)

`[build]` = failed when the verb (`mutate()`, `filter()`) was called; `[render]` = failed when the SQL text was made (`show_query()`, `collect()`); `[execute]` = failed in the database (`collect()`). Backends: `tibble` = in-memory dplyr; `duckdb` / `sqlite` = dbplyr lazy tables. Parts 4 (targets) and 5 (SQL Server / Oracle) have their own tables in `docs/` and their CSVs.
